description: Lightweight initiative entity — the parent container for a fleet deliverable spine. A cross-repo bet, feature area, or goal that groups related work artifacts. Artifacts carry initiative: <id> as a nullable FK. Roadmaps attach to an initiative as one kind of initiative; a cross-repo bet with no formal roadmap is still a first-class initiative. Stored per-initiative in state/initiatives/<id>.yaml. Spec backlink: the engine repo:pln-fleet-deliverable-spine-identity-and-facets-2b331c § D2

id.description: Stable initiative identifier (e.g. 'example-launch'). Used as the FK value in artifact frontmatter initiative: fields. Kebab-case; unique across the repo.

label.description: Business-legible display name (e.g. 'the studio Pro Launch'). Shown on the CEO board as the parent grouping label.

owner.description: EM or workstream identifier owning this initiative. Nullable — may be unassigned at inception.

status.description: Initiative lifecycle status. active=in flight; paused=temporarily blocked; shipped=done; abandoned=cancelled (legacy; new closures use closed); closed=terminal, with closed_reason and closed_at.

closed_reason.description: Why a status:closed record closed. NOT the handoff closed_reason (cancelled|displaced|stale, DR-084) — same field name, different vocabulary.

closed_at.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the record was closed.

target_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the intended completion, or null. null means ongoing / burn-down shape (no fixed end — work continues until the initiative is abandoned or shipped organically). A dated value means completion shape — the initiative has a concrete deadline and progress is tracked toward it. Spec backlink: pln-initiative-govern-sweep-priori-6cf808 § C1 (AC2)

goals.description: Optional many-to-many list of goal-ids this initiative contributes to. A goal-id pointing nowhere is a soft tag — no referential enforcement. Absent or empty means no goal linkage declared.

deliverable_id.description: The durable deliverable join key, minted once at the earliest artifact and carried verbatim by every downstream artifact. Null or absent when this record predates the spine. Spec backlink: pln-sizing-objects-join-the-delive-0fcd0a § C9c
